description: Shared Renovate policy for public repositories. Version updates only: security fixes come from Dependabot security updates, so Renovate's own vulnerability PRs are off.

customManagers.description: Sampo's GitHub Action, pinned by tag. The tag carries a prefix (cargo-sampo-github-action-v<version>), so Renovate's own github-actions manager cannot read its version
The sampo CLI when a workflow installs it from crates.io at a fixed version

packageRules.description: Group every patch update into one PR
Group every minor update into one PR, separate from patches
Group GitHub Actions updates together, except majors, which stay one PR per action
Label major updates so they can be found with label:dependency/major

Keep the 5-day release age for every version update. config:best-practices brings security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm, whose package rule sets npm to 3 days and would override the top-level minimumReleaseAge. Pins, lock file maintenance and replacements are left out: they carry no release timestamp, and Renovate's own rules set their age to null
